name: Basecamp Research
tagline: A biodiversity-scale protein database for training biological AI models.
description: A techbio company building BaseData, a proprietary database of protein and genome sequences collected from biodiversity worldwide under formal benefit-sharing agreements. The dataset is designed to train generative AI foundation models for protein and enzyme design, powering drug discovery, industrial biology and planetary-health applications that public databases can't reach.
insight: Its BaseData holds 9.8 billion protein sequences — a 10x expansion of known protein diversity over all public databases combined.
edge: Mines DNA from biodiversity worldwide under formal benefit-sharing to build the largest non-public protein database, then trains models on it.
pros: Built for training generative protein models
Backed by $85M+ across Series A and B
cons: Aimed at biotech teams, not general users
